constellations.name: Orion
constellations.description: Orion is a prominent constellation along the celestial equator named after a hunter in Greek mythology.

constellations.name: Ursa Major
constellations.description: Ursa Major is a large constellation in the Northern Hemisphere best known for containing the Big Dipper asterism.

constellations.name: Cassiopeia
constellations.description: Cassiopeia is a northern constellation easily recognized by its distinctive five-star
shape. It is named after a vain queen in Greek mythology

constellations.name: Scorpius
constellations.description: Scorpius is a prominent constellation recognizable by its curved body and long tail.

constellations.name: Cygnus
constellations.description: Cygnus is a northern constellation whose bright stars form a distinctive cross-shaped pattern.
